name: Orbital
tagline: AI copilot for real estate law and property due diligence.
description: Orbital (formerly Orbital Witness) is an AI platform purpose-built for real estate law. Its Orbital Copilot reviews and drafts complex property documents — title reports, leases, surveys, and contracts — extracting key provisions and flagging risks across a transaction. It is sold to law firms, insurers, and corporate legal teams via enterprise contracts.
insight: Rebranded from Orbital Witness; raised a $60M Series B in January 2026 led by Brighton Park Capital.

modelSupport.notes: Built on frontier LLMs, tuned for real estate legal documents.

edge: Purpose-built for real estate law rather than general legal AI — covers title, leases, and surveys, and powers 200K+ property transactions a year.
pros: Backed by JLL Spark, RELX (REV), Grosvenor
cons: Narrow to real estate legal work

references.title: Orbital raises $60M to modernize real estate law with AI
